T3.5.message: "sacred ash is the only ornament on His body" adds a claim that no pada makes. p6 vibhūtyaṅgabhūṣam means only 'whose body-ornament is ash' (the field's own literal: 'whose body-ornament is ash'; shlokam-vedasara-shiva-stava.md: 'whose body is adorned with sacred ashes'; gitapress-stotraratnavali.md: 'विभूतिभूषण'). No source word says 'only', and saying it is His only ornament makes a claim the verse does not.
T3.5.suggested_fix: "...the Lord of the universe, and His body is adorned with sacred ash."

T3.5.message: "भस्म ही उनके शरीर का एकमात्र आभूषण है" adds 'एकमात्र' (only), which no pada supports. p6 means only 'whose body-ornament is ash' (gitapress-stotraratnavali.md: विभूतिभूषण).
T3.5.suggested_fix: "...विश्व के नाथ हैं, और भस्म उनके शरीर का आभूषण है।"

T3.5.message: "जो भस्म को ही अपने अंगों का आभूषण बनाते हैं": the emphatic 'ही' makes it 'only ash', an exclusivity w6 does not state. The EN segment for w6 has no such emphasis, and the HI word meaning for w6 is simply 'जिनके अंगों का आभूषण भस्म है'.
